SELECT * FROM base_address WHERE dong_code IN
#{dongCode}
SELECT gugun_code, gugun_name FROM gugun_code JOIN sido_code ON SUBSTRING(gugun_code, 1, 2) = SUBSTRING(sido_code, 1, 2) WHERE sido_code = #{sidoCode} ORDER BY gugun_name
SELECT dong_code, dong_name FROM dong_code AS dc JOIN gugun_code AS gc ON dc.gugun_name = gc.gugun_name WHERE gugun_code = #{gugunCode} ORDER BY dong_name
SELECT gugun_code FROM gugun_code WHERE gugun_name = (SELECT gugun_name FROM dong_code WHERE dong_code = #{dongCode})

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT apt_code) FROM house_info
AND dong_code = #{dongCode}
AND SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 5) = SUBSTRING(#{gugunCode}, 1, 5)
AND SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 2) = SUBSTRING(#{sidoCode}, 1, 2)
AND apt_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT hd.no, hi.apt_code, hi.apt_name, hi.dong_code, hi.build_year, hd.area, hd.floor, hi.lat, hi.lng, hd.deal_year, hd.deal_month, hd.deal_day, hd.deal_amount FROM house_deal hd JOIN house_info hi ON hd.apt_code = hi.apt_code WHERE hd.apt_code = #{aptCode} ORDER BY hd.no DESC
